geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

lr.rule: successful-update warmup then cosine; independent of VAL

loss.auc: mean P*N softplus(a_neg-a_pos) per method; fixed TRAIN eligible denominator
loss.two_views: base and AUC independently evaluated on both dropout views then averaged
loss.target_rule: P: unique exact FP64 minimum; N: strictly greater than legal FP64 minimum; tied minima excluded

checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with common FULL TRAIN-fitted SBS; first wins ties
inference_rule: eval mode, original R77 maximin scores, stable ascending-global-solver-ID tie break
source_plan: unchanged R77 seed2 task order and per-task full-population shuffle streams
gradients: full1024 utility GradCache; sequential two-view micro RNG replay; one unscale/clip/step; same batch on AMP retry
train_eval: full TRAIN every5 VAL points, plus the selected best if absent
test: full TEST only after unique immutable VAL-best lock
test_rnd_disclosure: Earlier TEST results informed multi-round R&D; not an untouched blind evaluation
